text.tspan: M7/M8 is a 2v8 to 3v2 clamp, negligable leakage of 0.1uA
at 1.5v (compared with 32uA from a string of forward biased
diodes). At 1.8v, ie 200 degrees its still only about 0.2uA.
This is all very dependant on individual 2n7000, select on test,
spec say on at gate to drain between 0v8 and 3v (but pretty temp
stable) ! Current batch all around 1v4. Must be below 3.6v.
The ratio of R0 to R1 affects the temp coeff but
they both affect the set current (ie 1mA).
Values here seem to suit 1n914 diode.
Data file as written by raspicapture, <date>.scv
Date, n1, n2, n3, n4, n5, b1, b2, N1, N2, s1 + s2
n1..n5 : HotOut, Roof, TankLow, Ambient, SolarRet
b1, b2 : Pump 0=on, 1=off; Heater (currenly showing jam error)
N1, N2 : from Controller, Collect, TankLow
